I use Grok Bot.  Neuralink patient 3. ALS. Full quad. Nonverbal. I type with intention, not hands. Grok Bot is how a lot of that intention leaves the house.  Paste a YouTube link and it watches enough to know who is in it, drafts two longer promo posts — X and Facebook — in my voice. No hashtags. X gets verified @ tags later in the body, never leading. Facebook names people in plain text. It shows both drafts and waits. I say yes. It posts X as @ALScyborg from a signed-in session. Facebook goes on my Mac clipboard when that path is blocked. I still approve every public post. Judgment stays mine.  It also owns the Tuesday Holy War day-count. Days since Utah last beat BYU. Trash talk. Tags. Sometimes an image. Auto-post at 5:21pm Phoenix time. If X is down or suspended, it tells me and pauses. No silent failures.  This is not “AI wrote a cute caption.” This is an assistant that drafts, waits, posts, retries Unsent drafts when the Post button hangs, and keeps a standing ritual alive while I am busy living.  The bottleneck used to be hands. Now it is judgment — and I still own that. If you are waiting for permission to let software carry weight, the weight is already moving.

YOUR FORECAST OF THE YEAR:  Add your birth day + birth month and reduce the total to one digit. Example: August 22 → 2+2+0+8 = 12 → 1+2 = 3. Add the digits of the forecast year. 2026 → 2+0+2+6 = 10 → 1+0 = 1.  Add both numbers together and reduce again. 3 + 1 = 4. Your final number determines the year's theme.  MEANINGS:  1: Past difficulties fade, support increases, and confidence returns. Excellent for launching projects, creative work, competitions, investments, and major purchases. Success requires discipline- luck alone is not enough.  2: A socially and emotionally focused year. New connections, family, home, children, pregnancy, and property matters become important. Emotions may intensify, so patience and careful planning are essential.  3: Finish unfinished work, build your reputation, and expand financially. Favorable for business, writing, and public speaking. Family may become important. Avoid unnecessary bluntness and be cautious with contracts and agreements.  4: Hard work brings lasting financial and personal security. Favorable for property, marriage, family growth, travel, spirituality, and stronger professional relationships. Stay vigilant and avoid casual romantic entanglements.  5: Strong for travel, partnerships, international connections, finance, and media-related careers. Calculated professional risks can pay off. Be careful with communication and review contracts thoroughly.  6: Relationships, family, beauty, and artistic expression flourish. Romance, children, career improvements, and unexpected income are possible. Watch overspending on luxury, entertainment, and pleasure.  7: Progress may feel slow, with misunderstandings and extra effort, particularly in business. Excellent for healing, spiritual work, astrology, and legal matters. Friendships may be tested, so keep private matters private. Patience and optimism are crucial.  8: A powerful year for self-reliance, new ventures, competition, legal matters, and social involvement. Protect your health, manage stress, and use your energy wisely- focused effort brings greater rewards.  9: A cycle comes to an end with recognition, successful outcomes, institutional support, or unexpected gains. Good for organization and competition. Avoid stubbornness and conflicts with authority; spiritual focus helps you make the most of the year.

My preferred starting eleven for tonights game between #AFC and #NAP and a few little tactical notes I could see happen.  A tough opponent in Allegri's Napoli and the Stadio Diego Armando Maradona is not an easy place to go.   However, Napoli have started slow so far this season with 1 win and 2 losses: 2-0 win vs Genoa (a) 2-1 loss vs Como (H) 3-2 loss vs Inter (a), they were 2-0 up  They are likely to be in a base 4-3-3 (DM) prioritising a fluid and direct attacking approach over rigid positional structures. They will emphasise flexible deep build up play before looking for quick verticality.   OOP Napoli will deploy a structured low/mid block usually in a 4-5-1 shape. They will be happy to let us have possession. They will prioritise protection of central zones and primarily aim to harm us in transition with quick vertical runners like Hojlund (33.8 kmph) and Santos (33.3 kmph).   Last season Arteta made just 1 change before our opening   GK: David Raya  No words needed. He will likely be unbothered in terms of press today. He should 100% be starting over Kepa or Meslier  RB: Ben White  His fitness levels have looked good so far this season. Will have a difficult task against Alisson Santos who is a very high repitition take-on winger (61% dribble success with 2.54 per 90 (UCL and Serie A last szn). Ben White tends to struggle against high repition take on wingers compared to ball carrying wingers. I still back him to keep him quiet but he will have a lot of ground to cover today with Allegri's vertical approach.  RCB: Ezri Konsa  Will have a calmer day in possession with Napoli's press likely to be quite slow. His main job comes with dealing with their verticality. Hojlund or Mctominay (late runner) is the main task. Konsa is a superb recovery defender though and I feel he will have an important role with Gabriel stepping up to interact.  LCB: Gabriel  Has to be disciplined today. Easy choice and has to start.  LB: Hincapie  I'd make this change in the back line because I feel the overlapping nature of Hincapie could be another approach at times. Mainly the defensive security and recovery defending. Calafiori can be rested I feel.  DM: Rice  Has to start for me. Drop into CCB/RCB at times to allow Hincapie to make overlapping movements.  RCM: Merino  Odegaard has been fantastic so far this season and Merino has looked so secure every time he's come on for him. I feel he will do well in congested central spaces today.  LCM: Bruno G  Verticality could be crucial in unlocking Napoli's low block with consistency and venom. I personally would love to see him start. Such an incredible passing profile.  RW: Saka  60 minutes for Saka. Should do well against Spinazzola. Santos is not a great tracking defender so he may get moments in isolation. Will have to be awake in terms of tracking back too.  LW: Eze  I want to see him start. Especially alongside Hincapie as I feel Eze can be wasted as a touchline winger. He best influences the game from central pockets (LHS). Big year for him.  ST: Havertz  Last night I thought it would be good to have Gyokeres start (for fitness reasons) but tactically I think Kai is the better option. I think Gyokeres should definitely still get some minutes but Kai's positional fluidity on the right will be too much for Napoli to handle. I don't think todays game calls for someone like Gyokeres unless we hone in on creating transitions  Thoughts?

💸🔓 DEBT DOESN’T JUST COST INTEREST.  It costs:  Options.  Cash flow.  Sleep.  Flexibility.  Confidence.  Time.  And for millions of people, the hardest part isn’t knowing they have debt.  It’s answering:  “WHAT EXACTLY SHOULD I DO NEXT?”  Pay the smallest balance?  Attack the highest rate?  Consolidate?  Refinance?  Call the lender?  Change payment dates?  Build an emergency fund first?  What happens if I add $200 a month?  Which debt is actually hurting me most?  That confusion is the opportunity behind:  DebtFreeing.com  I wouldn’t build another generic budgeting app.  And I definitely wouldn’t build a company promising:  “WE’LL ERASE YOUR DEBT.”  I’d build:  THE DEBT ESCAPE OPERATING SYSTEM.  A financial platform with one measurable mission:  HELP PEOPLE MOVE FROM OWING → TO OWNING THEIR CASH FLOW AGAIN.  Not shame.  Not lectures.  Not financial theater.  A plan.  A timeline.  A next move.  🔥🔥🔥  🔓 MEET FREE™  Connect or manually enter:  Credit cards.  Personal loans.  Student loans.  Auto loans.  Lines of credit.  Other supported debts.  FREE™ organizes:  Balance.  Interest rate.  Minimum payment.  Due date.  Payment status.  Estimated interest.  Then immediately answers:  HERE’S WHERE YOU STAND.  And more importantly:  HERE’S YOUR NEXT MOVE.  🧬 DEBT DNA™  Two people can both owe:  $40,000  and have completely different problems.  One has:  $30K at 5%.  $10K at 21%.  Another has:  Ten revolving accounts.  Irregular income.  Multiple due dates.  Almost no monthly margin.  DebtFreeing builds the structure of the debt—not a judgment about the person.  UNDERSTAND THE DEBT BEFORE TRYING TO DESTROY IT.  🗺️ MY FREEDOM PLAN™  This should be the heart of the product.  DebtFreeing asks:  How much can realistically go toward debt each month?  Do you have emergency savings?  Is income stable?  Which payments are mandatory?  Which balances carry the highest rates?  Then build scenarios:  AGGRESSIVE  BALANCED  MINIMUM-STRESS  Each shows:  Monthly payment.  Estimated interest.  Projected payoff timeline.  Cash-flow impact.  And assumptions.  Now “become debt free” stops being:  A WISH.  It becomes:  A ROADMAP.  🧊 SNOWBALL MODE™  Prefer psychological momentum?  Attack the smallest eligible balance first.  $620  ↓  $1,450  ↓  $3,900  ↓  $8,200  Each eliminated payment gets rolled forward.  Then:  WATCH THE DEBTS DISAPPEAR ONE BY ONE.  🏔️ AVALANCHE MODE™  Want to prioritize interest cost?  Focus additional payments toward the highest-rate eligible debt while maintaining required payments elsewhere.  DebtFreeing can estimate:  Projected payoff date.  Projected interest.  Potential difference between strategies.  Then:  SHOW THE MATH.  Not:  “THIS IS ALWAYS THE BEST STRATEGY.”  Because real financial situations are more complicated than an algorithm.  ⚔️ SNOWBALL vs AVALANCHE™  This could be a fantastic acquisition feature.  Enter debts.  DebtFreeing shows:  SNOWBALL  Estimated debt-free date.  Estimated interest.  First account eliminated.  AVALANCHE  Estimated debt-free date.  Estimated interest.  First account prioritized.  Then:  CHOOSE THE PLAN YOU’RE MOST LIKELY TO FINISH.  🔥  ⏱️ FREEDOM DATE™  This could become the emotional center of the brand.  Instead of showing:  -$47,821  every morning…  show:  **ESTIMATED DEBT-FREE DATE  MARCH 2030**  Then every extra payment moves it.  $50 extra:  19 DAYS EARLIER  $500 bonus:  3 MONTHS EARLIER  Rate reduction:  TIMELINE UPDATED  Now progress becomes:  TIME YOU ARE BUYING BACK.  💸 INTEREST CLOCK™  Show estimated interest accumulating under the current scenario.  Not to scare people.  To make invisible cost:  VISIBLE.  Then show:  CURRENT PLAN  versus  +$100 / MONTH  Small decisions suddenly have context.  🔥 KILL THIS DEBT™  Pick one balance.  DebtFreeing shows:  Current balance.  Rate.  Minimum.  Additional-payment scenarios.  Estimated payoff.  Interest implications.  Then:  MAKE THIS ONE DISAPPEAR.  One target.  One mission.  Less cognitive overload.  💥 FOUND MONEY™  Tax refund?  Bonus?  Sold something?  Unexpected $1,500?  Ask:  WHERE WOULD THIS MONEY HAVE THE MOST IMPACT?  DebtFreeing models options.  Emergency reserve.  High-rate debt.  Multiple smaller balances.  Combination.  Then shows consequences.  The user decides.  AI MODELS. HUMAN CHOOSES.  ☕ THE $10 QUESTION™  Not:  “Stop buying coffee and you'll become rich.”  😂  Instead:  “If you redirected $10 per week, what would actually happen?”  Calculate it.  Maybe the impact is meaningful.  Maybe it barely changes the plan.  NO MORALIZING SMALL PURCHASES.  Show the math.  Let people decide what matters.  💵 PAYDAY ROUTER™  Money arrives Friday.  Before it disappears into the month:  DebtFreeing organizes:  Bills.  Minimum payments.  Savings target.  Living expenses.  Planned extra debt payment.  Then:  GIVE EVERY DOLLAR A JOB BEFORE THE WEEKEND DOES.  😂  📅 DUE DATE MAP™  One surprisingly stressful part of debt:  Timing.  3rd.  7th.  12th.  18th.  21st.  27th.  DebtFreeing creates:  ONE PAYMENT CALENDAR.  Upcoming payments.  Expected cash flow.  Minimums.  Autopay status.  Potential conflicts.  No need to discover a payment:  THE DAY AFTER IT WAS DUE.  🚨 CASH FLOW COLLISION™  Rent:  Tomorrow.  Credit card:  Two days.  Car:  Three days.  Payday:  Five days.  DebtFreeing flags:  TIGHT CASH-FLOW WINDOW AHEAD.  Then helps organize options the user can evaluate.  That is more useful than another pie chart telling them:  14% TRANSPORTATION.  🧯 LIFE HAPPENED™  Car repair.  Job interruption.  Medical expense.  Unexpected travel.  Home repair.  Instead of making the user feel like they:  FAILED THE PLAN  DebtFreeing says:  REBUILD PLAN.  Recalculate.  Protect essentials.  Update timeline.  Continue.  Because a realistic debt platform should understand:  PLANS CHANGE.  🛟 BUFFER FIRST™  Someone with $0 emergency savings may not benefit from sending every last available dollar toward debt if the next surprise goes straight back onto a credit card.  DebtFreeing could model:  DEBT-FIRST  BUFFER-FIRST  HYBRID  Then show the tradeoffs.  No universal prescription.  RESILIENCE MATTERS TOO.  📉 RATE SHOCK™  Variable rate changed?  DebtFreeing recalculates:  Payment implications.  Projected interest.  Freedom date.  Monthly margin.  Then:  SHOW ME WHAT CHANGED.  Financial planning becomes dynamic.  🔄 CONSOLIDATE?™  This could become a major commercial product.  User enters a proposed consolidation loan.  DebtFreeing compares:  Current weighted costs.  New rate.  Fees.  Term.  Monthly payment.  Total projected cost.  Payoff timeline.  Then highlights:  LOWER PAYMENT DOES NOT ALWAYS MEAN LOWER COST.  That single insight could save users from bad decisions.  🧮 REFINANCE LAB™  Current debt:  18.9%.  Offer:  10.5%.  Sounds obvious.  But include:  Origination fees.  New term.  Payment.  Total projected interest.  Early-payment conditions.  Other relevant costs.  Then compare:  OLD PATH vs NEW PATH.  Not:  APPROVED!  Not:  TAKE THIS LOAN!  Just:  UNDERSTAND THE TRADE.  📞 CALL MY CREDITOR™  People often don't know what to ask.  DebtFreeing can prepare a conversation checklist:  Current rate.  Payment history.  Available hardship programs.  Possible rate reduction.  Payment-date change.  Fee questions.  Repayment options.  Then:  MAKE THE CALL PREPARED.  The user speaks to the creditor.  The platform organizes the questions.  🤝 RELIEF NAVIGATOR™  Sometimes the situation is beyond optimization.  The user may need:  Accredited credit counseling.  A licensed insolvency professional.  Legal advice.  A legitimate hardship program.  DebtFreeing should recognize:  WHEN SOFTWARE ISN’T ENOUGH.  Then route users toward appropriate qualified help based on jurisdiction.  That's not weakness.  THAT'S TRUST.  🚫 SCAM SHIELD™  Debt distress attracts bad actors.  DebtFreeing could educate users about warning signs such as:  Guaranteed debt elimination.  Pressure to pay large upfront fees.  Claims that creditors can simply be ignored.  Fake government affiliations.  Promises that sound impossibly certain.  Then:  VERIFY BEFORE YOU PAY.  A debt-freedom brand should protect people from:  DEBT-RELIEF DEBT.  📄 READ THIS OFFER™  Upload or enter the terms of a loan or consolidation offer.  DebtFreeing helps organize:  Rate.  Term.  Fees.  Payment.  Total repayment.  Important conditions.  Then asks:  WHAT CHANGED VERSUS YOUR CURRENT PLAN?  AI assists understanding.  It doesn't invent terms that aren't present.  🧠 ASK FREE™  “What happens if I pay $300 more?”  “Why did my payoff date move?”  “Which debt currently has the highest rate?”  “How much interest does this scenario estimate?”  “What if my income drops for three months?”  “Should I compare consolidation?”  “What questions should I ask my lender?”  Now AI becomes:  THE EXPLANATION LAYER OF THE DEBT PLAN.  📸 SNAP MY DEBT™  Take an authorized photo of a statement.  DebtFreeing can help extract:  Balance.  Rate.  Minimum.  Due date.  Account type.  Then:  CONFIRM THESE NUMBERS.  User verifies.  Add to plan.  This could dramatically simplify onboarding.  💳 CREDIT CARD MODE™  Credit cards deserve their own experience.  Track:  Balance.  APR.  Minimum.  Due date.  Promotional rate.  Promotion expiration.  Then flag:  0% PERIOD ENDS IN 47 DAYS  or:  RATE CHANGE RECORDED  Now users can see:  THE TERMS THAT ACTUALLY CHANGE THE PLAN.  ⏳ PROMO EXPIRY™  A 0% balance transfer can look great—  until the promotional period ends.  DebtFreeing watches the deadline and models:  Remaining balance at expiry.  Potential new rate.  Required pace to hit target.  Then:  DON'T LET THE CALENDAR SURPRISE YOU.  🏠 DEBT + MORTGAGE™  For homeowners:  Mortgage.  HELOC.  Credit cards.  Auto.  Other debt.  DebtFreeing can show the entire liability picture without casually recommending that unsecured debt be moved against the home.  Because:  LOWER RATE CAN COME WITH DIFFERENT RISK.  That deserves clear explanation and professional advice where appropriate.  👩‍❤️‍👨 COUPLE MODE™  Debt conversations can be uncomfortable.  Create:  Shared goals.  Individual debts.  Household obligations.  Private categories where appropriate.  Joint payoff scenarios.  Then focus the interface on:  THE PLAN, NOT THE BLAME.  That could be extremely powerful.  👨‍👩‍👧 FAMILY FREEDOM™  Parents can create goals:  Credit card free.  Car paid.  Student loan finished.  Emergency fund established.  Then:  WHAT HAPPENS AFTER THE DEBT?  Because the product shouldn't end at:  $0.  It should transition toward:  WHAT YOU CAN BUILD NEXT.  🎉 DEBT KILLED™  Balance reaches:  $0  Don't just remove it from the dashboard.  Celebrate.  VISA — PAID OFF  Original balance: $8,420  Time: 17 months  Then ask:  WHERE SHOULD THAT PAYMENT GO NEXT?  Roll it into another debt?  Emergency savings?  Another financial goal?  The freed payment becomes:  NEW CASH FLOW.  💰 FREED CASH™  This could be one of the strongest features.  Debt eliminated:  $487 / MONTH FREED  DebtFreeing doesn't only show:  YOU OWE LESS.  It shows:  YOU NOW CONTROL $487 MORE EVERY MONTH.  That changes the emotional frame completely.  🌅 AFTER DEBT™  When the last eligible debt reaches zero:  The product transforms.  Old dashboard:  DEBT REMAINING  New dashboard:  CASH FLOW FREED  Now help users organize future goals:  Emergency fund.  Home.  Retirement.  Education.  Travel.  Investing.  Business.  Whatever they choose.  The company doesn't lose the customer when the debt disappears.  THE RELATIONSHIP EVOLVES.  🏆 FREEDOM STREAK™  Not:  187 DAYS WITHOUT BUYING ANYTHING FUN.  😂  Instead track meaningful progress:  Payments on time.  Plan reviewed.  Debt eliminated.  Emergency buffer improved.  High-interest balance reduced.  No shame when life disrupts the streak.  PROGRESS WITHOUT GAMBLING MECHANICS.  🔐 PRIVATE BY DEFAULT™  Debt data reveals:  Finances.  Income.  Accounts.  Hardship.  Behavior.  DebtFreeing should make privacy structural:  Strong encryption.  Clear permissions.  Data minimization.  No selling hardship data.  No manipulative lender targeting.  No hidden financial vulnerability scoring.  No public shame. DECISION SUPPORT, NOT FAKE CERTAINTY.  🏦 LENDER MARKETPLACE™  This could eventually become commercially powerful—but must be designed carefully.  If users choose to compare:  Consolidation. 🤖 [GEMINI 분석] 2026-09-11 21:35 KST
🟠 위협 점수: 8/10 (높음)

### 1. 현재 주요 사이버보안 트렌드
최근 공격자들은 LLM을 활용한 프롬프트 엔지니어링 기법(PuzzleMask 등)을 통해 보안 정책을 우회하거나, ClickFix 및 TerminalFix와 같이 사용자의 부주의를 유도하여 악성 명령을 직접 실행하게 만드는 사회공학적 기법을 고도화하고 있습니다. 또한, 소프트웨어 공급망 공격이 지속되는 가운데 JFrog Artifactory와 같은 빌드 파이프라인 인프라를 직접 타겟팅하여 관리자 권한을 탈취하는 사례가 보고되고 있습니다 ([TheHackerNews](https://thehackernews.com/2026/09/attackers-chain-jfrog-artifactory-flaws.html)). AI 에이전트가 취약점을 탐색하고 공격 타임라인을 단축시키는 현상이 가속화됨에 따라, 방어 측에서도 AI 기반의 자동화된 보안 대응 플랫폼 도입이 필수적인 과제로 부상했습니다 ([Schneier on Security](https://www.schneier.com/blog/archives/2026/09/ais-compress-exploit-timeline.html)).

### 2. 주요 위협 행위자 / 캠페인
- **UNC3569**: Sogou Input Method 취약점을 악용하여 GRAYRABBIT 백도어를 배포하는 중국 연계 그룹 ([TheHackerNews](https://thehackernews.com/2026/09/china-linked-unc3569-exploited-sogou.html))
- **GoldFactory**: Android Work Profile 기능을 악용하여 Gigabud Trojan을 유포하는 모바일 뱅킹 악성코드 캠페인 ([DarkReading](https://www.darkreading.com/mobile-security/indonesia-android-banking-app-cloning-campaign))
- **Kimsuky**: 기능별 C2 서버를 분산 운용하는 새로운 LNK 악성코드를 국내 금융 문서로 위장하여 유포 ([이스트시큐리티 알약](https://blog.alyac.co.kr/5777))
- **Toy Ghouls**: HiveMQ MQTT 및 Matrix 프로토콜을 C2로 사용하는 신규 백도어 유포 ([Securelist](https://securelist.com/toy-ghouls-new-hivemq-and-element-backdoors/121270/))

### 3. 한국 관련 위협
- **시선AI**: 대한민국 공군 국방망 대상 AI 코딩 및 Secure Code 자동점검 에이전트 구축 사업 수주 ([데일리시큐](https://www.dailysecu.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=208408))
- **금융보안원**: 보이스피싱 대응을 위한 AI 기반 플랫폼 'ASAP' 활용 설명회 개최 ([데일리시큐](https://www.dailysecu.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=208406))
- **악성코드**: Kimsuky 그룹이 국내 금융 문서로 위장한 LNK 악성코드를 유포 중이며, LegionLoader가 ClickFix 방식으로 국내 사용자 타겟팅 ([이스트시큐리티 알약](https://blog.alyac.co.kr/5777), [AhnLab ASEC](https://asec.ahnlab.com/ko/95373/))

### 4. 주요 CVE / 취약점
- **CVE-2026-85706**: GitLab Path Traversal 취약점, 최대 심각도(Critical)로 즉시 패치 권고 ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/gitlab-urges-users-to-patch-max-severity-path-traversal-flaw/))
- **CVE-2026-85102 / CVE-2026-85103**: Check Point VPN RCE 취약점, 원격 코드 실행 가능 ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/check-point-patches-critical-vpn-vulnerabilities/))
- **CVE-2026-85046**: Google Chrome V8 엔진 Type Confusion 취약점, 실제 공격 악용 중 ([이스트시큐리티 알약](https://blog.alyac.co.kr/5776))

### 5. IOC 요약
- **CVE**: 
  - CVE-2026-85102, CVE-2026-85103 ([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/check-point-patches-critical-vpn-vulnerabilities/))
  - CVE-2026-85706 ([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/gitlab-urges-users-to-patch-max-severity-path-traversal-flaw/))
  - CVE-2026-85046 ([이스트시큐리티 알약](https://blog.alyac.co.kr/5776))

### 6. 즉각 대응 권고
- **패치 적용**: GitLab, Check Point VPN, Google Chrome 등 현재 악용 중인 취약점에 대한 최신 보안 업데이트를 즉시 적용하십시오.
- **사용자 교육**: ClickFix/TerminalFix 방식의 공격은 사용자가 직접 PowerShell 명령을 복사/붙여넣기 하도록 유도하므로, CAPTCHA 인증 창 등에서 의심스러운 명령 실행을 차단하도록 임직원 교육을 강화하십시오.
- **공급망 보안**: JFrog Artifactory 등 빌드 파이프라인 인프라에 대한 접근 제어를 강화하고, 비정상적인 관리자 권한 변경 로그를 모니터링하십시오.

### 7. 위협 수준 평가
- **점수**: 8/10
- **근거**: 다수의 제로데이 취약점이 실제 공격에 악용되고 있으며, 공급망 및 사회공학적 기법이 결합되어 기업 내부망 침투 가능성이 매우 높은 상황임.
